name: heatgate
description: Machine and per-app CPU heat, worker hints, and ESTIMATED energy (Wh) for local work.
long_description: Zero-dependency MCP server. Heat is CPU load used as a stand-in for chip heat. Energy figures are estimates: CPU-seconds x watts-per-core, not a power-meter reading. `run_throttled` stays disabled unless you turn on *Allow running commands*.

tools.name: heat_status
tools.description: Current machine heat: heat, load1, cores, cpu, temp_c

tools.name: should_pause
tools.description: Whether heavy work should pause now

tools.name: recommended_workers
tools.description: Worker count scaled down as heat rises

tools.name: app_heat
tools.description: Heat and CPU-seconds of one process tree

tools.name: energy_estimate
tools.description: ESTIMATED Wh from CPU-seconds or a pid

tools.name: run_throttled
tools.description: Run a command under heatgate (only if allowed)

allow_run.title: Allow running commands (1 = yes)
allow_run.description: Set to 1 to let the AI launch shell commands via run_throttled. Leave 0 to keep it disabled.
